modifiers: vertical upward arrow to the right

readings.meaning: extend time, deadline extension, or increase duration
count-up timer or elapsed time tracking
sort by time ascending or oldest first
increase timeout or session expiration limit

reasoning: An hourglass beside an upward arrow clearly combines time/duration with increase/extension. While it originates as a UI sort or count-up timer glyph, in a task list it maps well to the common real-world task of requesting a deadline extension, renewing a time window, or increasing a timeout limit.
